colorgrade_enabled.comment: Master toggle. When off the grading pass is a no-op and the image is vanilla.

adaptive_enabled.comment: Brightens dark places and settles back in the light, like an eye adjusting.

colorgrade_exposure.comment: Linear exposure multiplier applied before the tonemap. 1.0 is unchanged.

colorgrade_contrast.comment: Pivots around display mid-grey. 1.0 is unchanged, 0 is flat.

colorgrade_saturation.comment: 0 is greyscale, 1.0 is unchanged, above 1 oversaturates.

colorgrade_temperature.comment: White balance. Negative is cooler/bluer, positive is warmer/oranger.

colorgrade_tonemapstrength.comment: Blend between vanilla output and the filmic ACES curve. 0 disables the tonemap only.

adaptive_darkgain.comment: Exposure multiplier in pitch darkness. 1.0 disables the brightening.

adaptive_brightgain.comment: Exposure multiplier in full light. 1.0 leaves bright scenes as authored.

adaptive_brightenseconds.ingui: Eye adaptation: time to adapt to dark
adaptive_brightenseconds.comment: Seconds to settle after entering darkness. Slow, like real dark adaptation.

adaptive_darkenseconds.ingui: Eye adaptation: time to adapt to light
adaptive_darkenseconds.comment: Seconds to settle after stepping into light. Fast, like real light adaptation.
